prompts.title: Slow Push-In on a Champions League Night Frame

prompts.title: Lateral Track Across the Pitch With Restrained Parallax
prompts.prompt: From the provided input image, create a 6-second hyperrealistic animation in vertical 9:16 with a smooth lateral camera tracking movement. Everything drawn from the input image must remain intact — kit colours, crests, flags, pitch lines and architecture — with no invented players, details or events. Only animate what the reference supports: a visible ball moving across the turf with realistic friction and roll, players jogging or repositioning with plausible gait cycles, balanced limbs and stable anatomy, fabric responding to motion, turf texture gliding underfoot.
